notes: οὐκ is aligned to the 'no' of 'no gods' rather than joined with anything, θεοί being a plain noun and not a negative able to carry the negation on its own.
οἱ … γινόμενοι is split under rule 90: the article takes the single relativizer and the participle keeps 'are made'.
τῆς before Ἀσίας is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23, the ASV writing no determiner, so 'throughout' stays with the noun.
